summary.text: Angela Stroud is a Democratic member of the Wisconsin State Assembly from District 73 who is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election against Republican Frank Kostka.
Ballotpedia lists her profession as educator.

paragraphs.text: Angela Stroud's career experience includes working as an educator, and she has served as a member of the Sporting Heritage Council.
She took office in the Assembly in January 2025, succeeding Angie Sapik, and her 2025-2026 committee assignment is listed as Sporting Heritage.
